acapala.p: [Na+capala] (ti) CL=8 Not fickle, a person who is not fickle(a) Not fickle, steady,composed, (b) not fickle, not usually adorned with ornament. A person who is not fickle ,who doesnt usually adorn with ornament.

DOP: capala mfn. and m. [ ts ], 1. ( mfn. ) ( i ) unsteady, inconstant; thoughtless, inconsiderate, ill-mannered; frivolous; (according to cts) given to show and adornment ; Abh 1075 (lole … ~o); M I 32, 9 (uddhatā unnaḷā ~ā mukharā vikiṇṇavācā; Ps I 152, 11 : ~ā ti pattacīvaramaṇḍanādinā cāpallena yuttā) ≠ S V 269, 26 ≠ A I 70, 7 ; Dhp 33 (phandanaṃ ~aṃ cittaṃ dūrakkhaṃ dunnivārayaṃ ujuṃ karoti medhāvī; Dhp-a I 288, 4 : ekiriyāpathena asaṇṭhahanto gāmadārako viya ekasmiṃ ārammaṇe asaṇṭhahanato ~aṃ); Th 157 (uddhato ~o cāsiṃ; Th-a II 33, 6 foll. : ~o ti vanamakkaṭo viya anavaṭṭhitacittatāya lolo kāyamaṇḍana-vatthamaṇḍanādicāpalyayuttatāya vā ~o); 960 (telasaṇhehi kesehi ~ā añjanakkhikā rathiyāya gamissanti; Th-a III 86, 27 : kāyamaṇḍanaparikkhāramaṇḍanādinā cāpallena yuttā); Mil 93, 6 (dārako ~-tāya mantitaṃ guyhaṃ vivarati na dhāreti); Pañca-g 64 (niccappaduṭṭhā ~ā parapīḷakarā narā); Nidd I 380, 18 (imassa vā pūtikāyassa bāhirānaṃ vā parikkhārānaṃ maṇḍanā … keḷanā … gedhitatā gedhitattaṃ ~-tā cāpalyaṃ ayaṃ pabbajitassa vibhūsā, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se wr capalanā; Nidd-a I 413, 12 : ~-tā ti alaṅkārakaraṇaṃ); Vism 619, 26 (puggalassa paṭhamāni dasa vassāni mandadasakaṃ nāma tadā hi so mando hoti ~o kumārako); — ( ii ) quick, swift ; Abh 1075 (sīghe ~o); — ( iii ) slavering ;? ( None ;?) Ja VI 548, 27* (dīghuttaroṭṭho ~o kaḷāro bhagganāsako; 549, 18´ : ~o ti paggharitalālo); — 2. ( m. ) one who has thoughtlessly committed a crime ; Abh 738; — capalasakkharā in Ee, Se at Ja I 295, 11* is wr, prob. for ca lapasakkharā ( Be and Ja V 448, 29* so; Ce ca palasakkharā); — acapala , mfn. , not thoughtless or inconsiderate; steady, constant ; M I 470, 16 (āraññakena bhikkhunā … anuddhatena bhavitabbaṃ ~ena); A I 70, 12 (anuddhatā anunnaḷā ~ā); Th 682 (anuddhato ~o nipako saṃvutindriyo) = Ja VI 293, 28* (293, 30´ : ~o ti amaṇḍanasīlo); Ja V 203, 28* (anuddhataṃ ~am assa bhāsitaṃ; 206, 24´ : patiṭṭhitatāya ~aṃ); Pp 35, 8 ; — see also cāpalya.
CPD: a-capala , mfn., notwanlon, not inconsiderate ( esp. in speech ), MN l 32, 18 (anuddhata, anunnaḷa, + amu- khara, avikiṇṇavāca) = AN lll 199, 10 ≠ AN l 70, 11 ; MN l 470, 10 (anuddhata +); Ja V 203, 28* (~aṃ assa bhāsitaṃ; patiṭṭhitatāya ~aṃ, ib. 206, 24 '); Ja Vl 293, 28* (anuddhato + ~o = amaṇḍana-sīla), bor- rowed Jināl 244 (accapalo [ - ˇ ˇ - ], v. l. appacalo).
